title: While only background subagents hold the turn, coax shows the agent as working and new prompts as queued
body:
When the main agent finishes its reply but started a background subagent, the Claude adapter keeps the turn's `session/prompt` unanswered until the subagent ends (memory `claude-adapter-holds-turns-for-subagents`). coax treats the turn as in flight. So the working line keeps its spinner as if the main agent were busy, and a prompt sent then shows in the `queued` row. Claude Code takes such a prompt at once, the adapter closes the held turn, and the reply follows straight away. Jack saw this live on 2026-11-11: the spinner, then `test` marked queued, then an instant answer.

## Proposal

coax tells a held turn from a working one. A turn is held when it is in flight, at least one background subagent runs (the count from coax-47019c), no top-level tool call of the main agent is pending or in progress, and the main agent's last update was message text. While held:

- the working line drops the spinner and reads `waiting on 1 agent · esc to cancel`, with the count
- a prompt sent goes straight into the transcript as the person's message, not into the `queued` row, and the held turn's reply that follows ends the held turn as it does now
- Esc still cancels, which the adapter applies to the held turn and its subagents
close_reason: Landed in 4d4ac77 on dev. `Transcript::held` marks a turn that only subagents keep open, and the working line then reads `◴ waiting on 1 agent · esc to cancel` in cyan. For an agent that queues, a prompt sent during a held turn goes straight into the transcript, and `App::held_replies` absorbs the reply that ends the held turn. The status line reads `agents` in cyan in place of `idle` while subagents run after a turn. `Transcript::end_replay` keeps replayed calls out of `running_agents`.

notes.author: Jack Roddy/bd10c4a0
notes.text: The held-turn line belongs on the working line too, which by then carries the subagent count from coax-47019c. It reads as waiting on the agents, with no spinner for the main agent.

notes.author: Jack Roddy/bd10c4a0
notes.text: Gaps from coax-47019c (f4e9b89) to fix here as well. The status line's state item still reads `idle` while subagents run. A `Task` call replayed from a loaded session and left `in_progress` would count as running forever, so only subagents seen live in this run should count.
